description: This file defines retry policies and utilities for handling retries in network requests, including default configurations, retry logic, and functions to create retry runners with customizable behavior.

methods.name: resolveChannelApiShouldRetry
methods.description: Determines whether an error should trigger a retry based on a regex test and optional custom logic.

methods.name: getChannelApiRetryAfterMs
methods.description: Extracts the retry-after duration in milliseconds from an error object, if available.

methods.name: createRateLimitRetryRunner
methods.description: Creates a retry runner with rate limiting and optional verbose logging.

methods.name: createChannelApiRetryRunner
methods.description: Creates a retry runner specifically for channel API calls, with options for strict retry logic and verbose logging.
